injectivity.proof: Let N1=sum T1. In every image history, the unique split after exactly N1 transitions recovers the full prefix gamma and suffix eta, including their shared join packet. Thus two input pairs with the same concatenation are equal.

no_product_formula_for_mu: No probability, entropy, or multiplicative cardinality law is asserted.

counterexample.reason: The other target history has total table T1+T2 but its first N1=2 transitions realize T2 rather than T1, so it is not in the image of the fixed ordered split.
